health._note: Live-verified on 2026-08-23: 33 postings on the board, 24 Israel-relevant. expected_min_jobs=6 is a deliberately conservative floor (about 25% of what was observed), because this half of the health gate exists for slow decay over months - sudden breakage is caught by the relative-collapse check in state.py, which needs no number here. zero_is_plausible is false and that is now a real assertion rather than an inherited default: this board demonstrably carries Israeli roles, so a zero from it means something broke.
